name: iFi
tagline: Just a guy eating way too much ramen and tracking every bowl.
bio: Hey, I'm iFi. At some point I started writing down every bowl of ramen I ate in Japan, and now it's a spreadsheet, and now it's a website. Nobody asked for this.
My rating system is extremely scientific: I eat the ramen, I think about it on the train afterwards, and I give it a number. If I'm still thinking about it a week later, it's a 9+.
I'm not a chef or a food critic. I just have a lot of opinions about broth and zero self-control around a ticket machine. Next up: more bowls, probably.
